title: Chicken with Onion Thyme Sauce
reject_reason: Floured seared chicken with an onion + broth + flour pan gravy is the same chicken-smothered-in-onion-gravy dinner as live smothered-chicken-onion-gravy; the thyme/rice-vinegar accent doesn't change the plate, and it doesn't widen the American-skewed catalog.
